name: refactor_go_table_driven_tiers
description: Refactors a repetitive threshold switch into a table-driven lookup without changing behavior
prompts: TierName(points int) string in tiers.go returns a loyalty tier using a switch: points >= 1000 -> "platinum", >= 500 -> "gold", >= 100 -> "silver", otherwise "bronze". Refactor it to be table-driven: define a slice of {minimum points, tier name} entries ordered from highest to lowest and loop over it, returning the first tier whose minimum the points meet. Do not change observable behavior: every points value maps to the same tier as before (the boundaries are inclusive: exactly 500 is gold). Keep the TierName(points int) string signature. The file is package main.
